title: Cinematic Los Angeles: first 100 location and route candidates

scope.narrative: Scenes set in Los Angeles or its metropolitan communities
scope.physical: Real filming sites within the Los Angeles region
scope.media: 19 feature films, Bosch, and Star Trek: Voyager television appearances
scope.editorial_premise: A shared fictional city built from independently sourced screen appearances; cross-title occupant history is the site's editorial premise.
scope.excluded: Los Angeles filming sites representing other cities or fictional towns; unanchored studio-only locations

research_status.summary: Source-backed research shortlist, not a finished geocoded or frame-by-frame audited database.
research_status.dates: Release years identify works. Canonical story time is recorded separately, with precision, certainty and evidence; it does not establish a complete period of residence or employment.
research_status.route_geometry: Unshown transitions are gaps. No routing-service paths have been invented.
next_checks: Normalize address directionals and locality where flagged.
Verify precise pin positions and property boundaries.
Add scene timecodes tied to a named cut of each film.
Research canonical dates and distinguish witnessed occupancy from established move-in, move-out and employment dates.

temporal_policy.calendar: Local canonical story time in Los Angeles, including historical dates visited by time travelers.
temporal_policy.occupancy: A dated appearance establishes that a character is associated with a place during that story; move-in, move-out and job dates require separate evidence. Unknown bounds do not mean an unlimited duration.
temporal_policy.range_filter: Match dated appearances and events against the selected range. Keep undated entries separately selectable, and distinguish uncertain temporal matches from confirmed ones.
temporal_policy.partial_dates: Retain known month/day or relative sequence even when a calendar year or exact timestamp is unresolved.
